messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] modeled/grouped variance parameters?
parts:
I think you want to treat this as a general linear model, in other words

theta_{i} ~ normal(mu, tau); // hierarchical model
sigma_{i} <- exp( theta_{i}); // map to constrained scale assuming log link function

I’ve built similarly models that do this for the negative binomial dispersion
parameter and it has worked reasonably well.
